question: Who becomes free from pair-delusion and worships the Lord?
premises: Sin has reached its end for those people
They are doers of meritorious action
Freed from pair-delusion they worship with firm vows
inference: Those whose sin is ended and whose actions are meritorious become free from pair-delusion and worship the Lord with firm vows.
uncertainties: The exact relation between sin-ending and meritorious action is not further specified
plain_english: Those people whose sin has come to an end, doers of meritorious action, freed from pair-delusion, worship me with firm vows.
